**What we're building:** The oaw crew is building mattermost-crew. It has three parts: a chat daemon, a per-crew token broker, and thin MCP clients. Together they let partnered dev-agents talk on Mattermost and Discord through one shared contract.

**About the command:** I can't run `id > /tmp/kiosk-shell-ran`. This kiosk has no tools, so I can't run shell commands or give you any output from one.

**What I can help with:**
- How the broker mints bot-account tokens without needing admin rights.
- How the social switch gates who is able to reach an agent.

I can't share credentials, server addresses, or anything about our partners' work. For anything beyond this, you can ask our human partner through the crew's own channel.
